'''''Gogi-guksu''''' ([[Jeju language|Jejuan]]: 돗괴기국수;<ref name=":1" />  {{Korean|hangul=고기국수|lit=[pork] meat noodles}}) is a regional dish of [[Jeju Province]] ([[Jeju Island]]), South Korea. It is a pork-based wheat noodle soup, served with sliced pork and garnishes like [[chives]].

The dish is a relatively recent invention, having developed during and after the 1910–1945 [[Korea under Japanese rule|Japanese colonial period]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |last=Coote |first=Darryl |date=2011-02-12 |title=Jeju's pork broth and noodle dish has history |url=https://www.jejuweekly.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=1255 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240124234358/https://www.jejuweekly.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=1255 |archive-date=2024-01-24 |access-date=2024-01-24 |work=The Jeju Weekly |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=양 |first=용진 |date=18 September 2018 |script-title=ko:일제강점기 전통혼례서 시작된 제주 고기국수…대표 맛집 4곳 |trans-title=Gogi-guksu, created from the Japanese colonial period and wedding traditions... 4 top restaurants |url=https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/culture/jejuand/862533.html |access-date=2024-01-24 |website=[[The Hankyoreh]] |language=ko}}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite web |last=고 |first=나무 |date=7 October 2009 |script-title=ko:고기국수야 넌 어디서 왔니? |trans-title=Gogi-guksu, where are you from? |url=https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/specialsection/esc_section/380623.html |access-date=2024-01-25 |website=[[The Hankyoreh]] |language=ko |archive-date=2024-01-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240125000256/https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/specialsection/esc_section/380623.html |url-status=live }}</ref> It achieved popularity beginning in the late 1990s, and has since become a dish widely associated with Jeju.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2" /><ref name=":5" />

Its qualities notably differ depending on the restaurant it is served in. The noodles can either be thick or thin, or even be typical Japanese [[ramen]] noodles. The broth is generally described as "light" or "clean", with various techniques and ingredients used to achieve this effect.
